items.title: Finite locally constant sheaves are exactly the sheaves represented by finite etale schemes
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file etale-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma characterizes finite locally constant sheaves of sets on the small etale site as exactly those represented by finite etale schemes (statement lines 9993-10001). The proof is a complete argument in both directions: one direction follows from the local structure of finite etale morphisms (proof lines 10004-10005); conversely a finite locally constant sheaf is trivialized over an etale covering, the local representing objects are shown to carry a descent datum by the same construction as in the cited descent lemma (proof lines 10005-10008), and effectivity together with the descent results for finiteness and etaleness produces the desired morphism (proof lines 10008-10018). The non-formal content is the descent step and the transfer of the two properties. The claim is H2: a two-direction argument with every descent input named.
